name: Tottori Castle
description: Tottori Castle was the Ikeda domain seat; its highlight is the 10 m-high stone walls built on the cliff face in 1750 (Ishigaki no Tan). The ruins, with the Kyusho-maru tower site, form the castle park in the city center.
notes: Free to walk; the 'Ishigaki no Tan' wall section is the must-see.
